744200.source_text: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!
744200.text: 建造、製作、破壞！在這款以奇幻浮空島世界為舞台的線上沙盒冒險中，躍上雲端，運用鋼鐵、魔法與靈魂之力，在講究技巧的戰鬥中對抗可愛的怪物！

1167820.source_text: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?
1167820.text: 在這款結合 Roguelike 要素的模擬遊戲中，擔任海關人員，每只行李箱都可能暗藏風險。檢查文件、盤問旅客、掃描行李並查扣違禁品，努力維持 Caldora 機場的秩序。你會堅守法律，還是靠走私品牟利？

1374860.source_text: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.
1374860.text: 死後世界已經數位化。在這款融合多種風格、採用獨特節奏戰鬥的角色扮演遊戲中，探索永生背後必須付出的代價。

2411200.source_text: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear and descend into the depths of the Underkeep to uncover what lies hidden below.
2411200.text: 在這款採用策略回合制戰鬥的地城探索角色扮演遊戲中，踏入危機四伏的奇幻世界。組建冒險隊伍、升級裝備，深入 Underkeep，揭開地底深處隱藏的祕密。

3462190.source_text: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?
3462190.text: 一場詭異的疾病籠罩 Flint Peak 小鎮，神祕生物在街頭遊蕩，幾名倖存者設法逃出生天。在這款經典風格的生存恐怖遊戲中，面對駭人怪物、解開謎題並查明真相。你能逃離這場惡夢嗎？

4705510.source_text: Choose your inadequately prepared racer, and disregard severe consequences in your desperate pursuit of short-lived victory.
4705510.text: 挑選一位準備不足的參賽者，無視可能造成的嚴重後果，拚命追求那短暫的勝利。

4739040.source_text: 🔥 UP TO 8-PLAYER HARDCORE DISCIPLINE SIMULATOR!!! 💪 Build power at max speed and WIN! Upload your target pics, use gadgets, and wreck faces in insane massive brawls! Dominate, sweat, and become the ABSOLUTE GOD OF DISCIPLINE!!! 😈
4739040.text: 🔥 最多支援 8 人的硬派紀律模擬器！💪 全速鍛鍊力量，贏得勝利！上傳你的目標照片、使用各式小道具，在瘋狂的大規模混戰中痛擊對手。揮灑汗水、稱霸全場，成為至高無上的紀律之神！😈
